what: Observation: the throughput review keeps generating high-priority landing-design requests from its 'landing and rebuild' stage figure (1537, then 1842, then 1997 minutes per landed job). The design notes, two verifiers and the redone design all say this figure is mostly a measurement effect of stacked landing commits, not real waiting. Three design jobs have now been written on the false premise; two were rejected for it.
why: The cause is upstream of the design jobs: the throughput review's stage measure, and the review proposing work from a figure its own records contradict. Reporting it so Athena's loop fixes the measure instead of re-asking for designs. Not fixing it by hand.
